text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan delivered a spectacular run. 
Seeing her receive thunderous applause, 
the Trainer choked back tears of joy. 
Aston Machan looked bewildered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Life is a journey meant to be walked 
alone. And yet, she says she finds it 
puzzling how her Trainer tries to stay by 
her side as closely as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Eventually, Aston Machan came to a 
conclusion. A Trainer who does things 
completely beyond her common sense is 
simply a 'weird person.'

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Believing that as long as this person was 
here, she wouldn't disappear, her hurried, 
fleeting aura softened. She presents the 
Trainer with an Aston Machan doll.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, they discussed her next race 
for the first time. Together, they decided 
on the Takamatsunomiya Kinen as the next 
target!
